text.en:
Sitios Ubong Sur and Dollar, both of Barangay Lian Norte (San Luis), in the Municipality of
Enrile, province of Cagayan, are hereby detached and separated therefrom to form and constitute into a
distinct and independent barangay which is hereby created to be known as Barangay Don Antonio without
affecting in any manner the legal existence of Barangay Lian Norte.

Except as hereinafter provided, all provisions of law, now or hereafter applicable, to regular
barangay shall be applicable to the new Barangay Don Antonio.

The present elective barangay officials of Lian Norte (San Luis) shall continue to perform their
duties as such officials in the newly-created barangay of Don Antonio until the Barangay officials of said
barangay shall have been appointed by the President. Such officials so appointed shall hold office until their
successors shall have been elected in the issuance of this Decree shall have qualified, unless sooner removed
at the pleasure of the President. Such appointive officers and employees as may be necessary to organize or
complete the government personnel of Barangay Don Antonio shall be appointed as provided for under
existing laws.

Upon the effectivity of this Decree, the proportionate share of the new barangay of Don Antonio
in the obligations, funds, assets and other property of Barangay Lian Norte (San Luis) shall be transferred by
the President of the newly-created barangay upon the recommendation of the Commission on Audit.

All laws or parts of laws as well as all executive orders or regulations inconsistent herewith are
hereby repealed or modified accordingly.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 11th day of June, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-eight.
